videos.title: Politics Aside with Chris Cillizza
videos.description: In this episode of Politics Aside with Chris Cillizza: America's Gladiators, Chris talks military service and fitness with two American warriors serving in Congress. Former Naval Intelligence Officer, Jimmy Panetta (D-CA), and former US Marine and USN Emergency room physician Rich McCormick (R-GA). Along the way, Chris skates through the halls of Congress, takes a stab at the Marine Sword Salute, and has his fitness tested by a real American Gladiator.
